KEY DESIGN DECISIONS

1. Model Comparison Layout: Implemented a side-by-side time-series chart allowing planners to visually cross-check Prophet and XGBoost forecast trajectories against actual sales.

2. Progressive Disclosure: Separated high-level MAPE accuracy indicators from granular parameter tuners, keeping the main interface focused on operational action.

3. Role-Based Views: Designed dedicated dashboard perspectives in SAPUI5 for production planners vs. inventory management.

ENGINEERING EXECUTION

TRANSLATING FIGMA DESIGNS INTO REACT 18 CODE

How component-driven engineering, synchronized design tokens, and smooth motion deliver responsive interfaces.

01. Atomic Components

Structuring interfaces into Atoms (Buttons, Badges), Molecules (KPI Cards), and Organisms (Forecast Cockpit) with strict TypeScript prop contracts.

React 18 • TypeScript
02. Tokenized CSS

Figma color tokens map directly to Tailwind CSS variables (--bg, --red, --line), maintaining strict 8px layout rhythm.

Tailwind CSS Tokens
03. Responsive Fluidity

Fluid clamp typography (clamp(44px, 10vw, 98px)) and strict overflow-x: clip rules prevent horizontal layout breakage.

Mobile to 1440px
04. Smooth Motion

Hardware-accelerated GPU transforms with Apple Expo Out easing. Touch devices gracefully disable tilt effects to respect battery life.

Framer Motion
// PRODUCTION TYPE-SAFE MOTION INTERFACE src/lib/motion.ts 
// Apple Expo Out Easing Curve
export const ease = [0.22, 1, 0.36, 1] as const;

export const fadeUp = {
  hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 24, filter: 'blur(6px)' },
  show: { 
    opacity: 1, 
    y: 0, 
    filter: 'blur(0px)', 
    transition: { duration: 0.8, ease } 
  },
};

export const springTransition = {
  type: 'spring',
  stiffness: 350,
  damping: 25,
};
Ensures smooth transitions without layout shifts.
